description: This file contains functions and classes for handling encrypted file storage, upload/download, decryption, and error handling within the Notesnook project. It manages file encryption, decryption, streaming, and interaction with external storage APIs.

classes.name: FileStorage
classes.description: Object implementing IFileStorage interface for managing encrypted file operations including upload, download, decryption, and deletion.

classes.name: WrappedError
classes.description: Custom error class used for wrapping errors with additional context during file operations.

methods.name: writeEncryptedFile
methods.description: Encrypts a file and writes it to storage, returning encryption metadata.

methods.name: writeEncryptedBase64
methods.description: Converts base64 data to Uint8Array, hashes, encrypts, and stores it, returning metadata.

methods.name: hashBuffer
methods.description: Generates a hash for given data buffer using xxhash64.

methods.name: hashStream
methods.description: Hashes a readable stream of Uint8Array chunks.

methods.name: readEncrypted
methods.description: Reads and decrypts an encrypted file, returning the output in specified format.

methods.name: streamingDecryptFile
methods.description: Streams and decrypts a file, returning a readable stream.

methods.name: decryptFile
methods.description: Decrypts a file and returns it as a Blob.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Decrypts and saves a file to the user's device.

methods.name: uploadFile
methods.description: Uploads a file, handling single or multipart upload based on size.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a file from storage, verifying size and integrity.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a file from storage or via API.

methods.name: getUploadedFileSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of an uploaded file from the server.

methods.name: bulkExists
methods.description: Checks existence of multiple files in storage.
